notes.title: End of Early Access ● Patch Note 2.0.0 ● Special Offer ● Wallpaper Giveaway
notes.notes:
Dear beloved community, 

First, we would like to express our gratitude for your love & support for our games. We also owe you an apology. We had ambitious dreams for Hero by Chance II but also made some regrettable mistakes. Our game was plagued with bugs, incorrect translation, unbalanced gameplay, and confusing unlocking features, resulting in a less-than-ideal experience. We deeply regret the frustrations this caused.

Over the past six months, we've been tirelessly listening to your valuable feedback and working hard to turn things around. Your passion for Hero by Chance II and your dedication to helping us improve it inspired us to do better. [b][i]Today, we're thrilled to announce that we are exiting early access and releasing the final version on Steam.[/i][/b]

[u][b]Our Solution and Unwavering Effort:[/b][/u]
👂 [b]Listening to Feedback[/b]: Your voices were heard loud and clear. We read every comment, review, and message sent our way. 
🐞[b]Bug Fixes[/b]: We've combed through every inch of the game, eliminating pesky bugs that marred your gaming experience and improving translation accuracy.
⚖️ [b]Rebalanced Gameplay[/b]: The battles you'll face will now be more strategic and satisfying. Your skills will be the determining factor in your victories.
➕[b]New Features and Content[/b]: As a gesture of gratitude for your patience and support over the year, we released a big update, including a new system for special scenes, dating, new units, items, legacy outfits, and more.
🎮[b] We incorporate all these great changes into the DLC Romance & Reprisal, inheriting numerous improvements[/b]: a lighthearted story that concludes our Hero’s first journey, better romance, exciting gameplay features, powerful new units, and an Arena for continued play after completing the main story.
💕Amidst the current economic situation, we understand your circumstances and remain devoted to affordable price points for our games. This commitment reflects our gratitude for your feedback and support. Join hands with us to build better games and a stronger community.

🔥 As we've mentioned, you can now [u]get Hero by Chance II with 40% off[/u] from today!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1627680/Love_n_War_Hero_by_Chance_II/

notes.title: Regional Price Update
notes.notes:
Dear our valued Heroes,

We would like to inform you that there will be price changes in our games starting from 7:00 AM March 26th, 2023 UTC [i](Hero by Chance, Warlord by Chance II and its expansion Sisters of Castus)[/i] in some regions based on changes in currency exchange rates and other factors from Steam to ensure that all players around the world are able to purchase games at a fair price. This update just affects prices in certain regions around the world, especially Turkey and Argentina. You can check it out [url=https://steamdb.info/blog/valve-price-matrix-2022-update/#2-99-usd]here[/url].

We would like to be as transparent and fair for all as possible. The price changes were a very tough decision for us. Our current price points are lower than the quality of our games, and while we love being able to offer our games at such a reasonable price, we simply aren't able to sustain our production costs at this level.

By increasing the prices a little more, we'll be able to continue producing games at a high level of quality, which we know is important to you. We wanted to assure you that this increase is minimal and necessary for us to continue providing the quality gaming experience that you have come to know and love.

We appreciate your support and loyalty to our series, and we hope that you'll continue to enjoy playing it as much as we enjoy creating it.

If you have any questions or concerns, please don’t hesitate to reach out to us.

Don’t forget to add our upcoming games to your Wishlist.
